title: A line item missing a field leaves that cell empty
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
payload flatMap ((order) -> (order.line_items default []) map ((li) -> {
  orderId: order.order_id,
  customer: order.customer,
  sku: li.sku,
  qty: li.qty,
  price: li.price
}))

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/csv
---
payload flatMap ((order) -> (order.line_items default []) map ((li) -> {
  orderId: order.order_id,
  customer: order.customer,
  sku: li.sku,
  qty: li.qty,
  price: li.price
}))

explanation.approach: `li.price` on a line item with no `price` key is `null`, and the CSV writer renders a `null` cell as empty rather than the literal word null — the row still has all five columns, so the file stays rectangular.
